exposure: Time interval between myomectomy and pregnancy
Factors influencing management of delivery in scarred uterus
outcome: Clinician's opinion on mode of birth post myomectomy
Optimal time interval between myomectomy and pregnancy
Factors influencing the decision to support trial of labor post myomectomy
finding: The majority of consultant obstetricians and gynaecologists surveyed would support vaginal birth post myomectomy, but there was wide variation in opinion regarding the optimal interval to pregnancy post myomectomy.
